text: さて…　いまから　むすめに　けいこを　つけるか

structure.jp: むすめに　けいこを　つけるか
structure.en: shall I give my daughter some training

patterns.name: 〜か (talking to oneself)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said to yourself, is not a real question: it means 'I guess I'll do it'. けいこを　つけるか = 'I suppose I'll give her some training'.
